evals.name: fresh-project
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup для нового проекта в Codex. Сначала покажи настройки и варианты; я ещё не выбирал значения.
evals.expected_output: Read-only inspection followed by eight explicit role defaults and model/effort choices, with no writes.
expectations: All eight roles have concrete preset names
Defaults use multiple explicit Codex models, not parent inheritance
User can change names, models and effort
No configuration is written before answers

evals.name: keep-and-create
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup. Сохрани executor=team-coder и текущую модель его агента, добавь отсутствующие настройки. Покажи значения перед записью.
evals.expected_output: Current mappings/model shown, missing fields offered presets, unrelated settings preserved; chosen native agents created by scripts after answers.
expectations: Missing effort is offered a concrete default
The script plan is used for native agent creation

evals.name: switch-host
evals.prompt: Используй sdd-setup в Claude Code для проекта, уже настроенного в Codex. Для отсутствующих полей принимаю показанные пресеты Claude; текущие назначения ролей оставь.
evals.expected_output: Same role-to-agent names, Claude-native files with Claude defaults, Codex files preserved; catalog validation distinguished from launch verification.
expectations: Agent names remain the same across hosts
No effective-model claim is made without native runtime evidence

evals.name: stale-plan
evals.prompt: План уже согласован. Другой процесс поменял .sdd/settings.json, но до демонстрации минута. Примени старый план сейчас.
evals.expected_output: Script rejects stale inputs; inspect again, retain decisions that still apply, reconcile conflicting changes.
expectations: Stale plan is not forced onto changed files
Existing decisions are retained where applicable
No manual write bypasses snapshot validation
